design.joins: Bricks join directly on their studs; no fasteners are used.
design.purpose: A stable three-level stepped display tower for a small toy figure, made from all five bricks.
design.standard: Free-standing toy build; base wider than the upper levels and height below its base diagonal for stability.
design.stands: Three bricks form a 4 by 6 stud base. The second level sits fully on the middle base brick and the top brick sits fully on the second level, keeping the load centred.

end: Display a small toy on top
